what_it_does: Designs a millimeter-wave power amplifier for wireless arrays (phased arrays) at 24 gigahertz that efficiently handles high-order modulated signals while directing radio beams. Instead of handling beamforming and power efficiency separately, this design integrates both functions into a single amplifier that can adjust both signal amplitude and phase directly in the digital domain, improving efficiency when transmitting complex signals that require significant power reduction for interference mitigation.
